newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pernod reticent on alliances - paper.
newsitem.headline: Pernod reticent on alliances - paper.

text.p: French drinks group Pernod Ricard has a cautious approach to alliances but remains pragmatic and responsive to the market, chairman Patrick Ricard said in a newspaper interview published on Monday.

Asked if family-controlled Pernod was seeking alliances in the face of the planned merger between Britain's Guinness Plc and Grand Metropolitan Plc, Ricard told daily newspaper Le Figaro that size was not an objective in itself.
"Our strategy is above all dictated by the expectations of the consumer," he said.

"In a general sense, the group has always been rather reticent of alliances which we think are made to be undone, as recent events show...That being said, we remain pragmatic and aware of the market," he said.
Asked if his company would be interested in buying brands which the merged Guinness/Grand Met would be required to sell, Ricard said he would consider it when the moment came.
